methods.name: FedSeIT
methods.description: A method used in FCL setup to align and relevance of foreign tasks parameters at each client to minimize inter-client interference and improve inter-client transfer learning without dense-layer-sharing.

methods.name: FedWeIT
methods.description: Baseline model where weighted additive filter composition is performed.

methods.name: FedSeIT+DLS
methods.description: Variant of FedSeIT with dense layer sharing.

methods.name: Federated Selective Inter-client Transfer (FedSeIT)
methods.description: Aims to minimize inter-client interference and communication cost while maximizing inter-client knowledge transfer in Federated Continual Learning (FCL) paradigm.

methods.name: Selective Utilization of Global Knowledge
methods.description: Each client initializes Bt c using θG received from the server before training on task t, enabling inter-client knowledge transfer.
